title: Elections — Verification-First Election Intelligence Lab
description: Verification-first election intelligence project using free, public, official data only: it backtests polls and prediction markets against verified official outcomes, flags every irregularity it finds, and runs a paper-trading forecasting contest, reverse-engineered from TradingView's The Leap, on Kalshi's open political and election markets. State counted from the repository's own files at commit dae1427: data/sources/master.json holds 267 entries (258 verified, 3 verified-claim, 2 verified-via-search, 4 needs-review), each carrying a manual-review link, the observed verification text, a date, a status and a category — and the README's banner and source table both agree with that file at 267, which closes the 209-versus-189-versus-229 divergence this directory recorded as IRR-67. The README's two other count complaints are closed too, and one of them closes a defect in this directory's own earlier entry: the README describes data/master_sources.json as 20 live-only entries and data/flagged_sources.json as 7 excluded sources, and the files hold exactly 20 and 7 — the previous version of this entry published "6 and 4", which was len() of each file's top-level dict (6 keys and 4 keys) rather than a count of its sources array, corrected here (IRR-95). The banner's '84 irregularities' is the highest id in data/irregularities.json, which holds 74 items. The 2024 market backtest covers 39 settled markets: at T-1 the 37 priced markets gave a mean Brier score of 0.077 and mean log-loss 0.271 with the favourite winning 34 of 37 (91.9 percent), while at T-7 the 25 markets gave Brier 0.104 with the favourite right 23 of 25. The captured open universe for the live 2026 layer is data/kalshi/forward/universe-open.json, which at this head holds 24,141 markets from 4,226 of 4,226 eligible series, complete true, captured 2026-09-23T00:33:32.866Z — while the README still prints 24,150 in its file table, 24,102 in its canonical-list section and 24,139 in its All Markets paragraph, so the file is the number of record (IRR-96). Daily collection runs on cron 12:30 UTC plus a push trigger. The site gained an All Markets page over the full captured universe, npm test reports 163 tests, and the live 2026 contest (R16, season S1-2026, opened 2026-09-19) fields 12 entrants with 41 tests of its own, 3 of the 12 having met the 3-day minimum over 5 captured trading days. GitHub Pages reported errored for two consecutive builds before the previous head and reports built at this one (IRR-83).
